## What's new
- **Nine new styles, the same as AC Multichat and Music Now Playing:** Glass, Pill, macOS window, Line, Synthwave, Neon city, Cyberpunk, Retro and Glitch (VHS, with its periodic jumps). Minimal, Bold and Neon are unchanged.
- **Background opacity** for the card styles (85 % by default). The accent and text colors only show for the styles that use them.
- The Synthwave, Cyberpunk and Glitch fonts (Mr Dafoe, Orbitron, VT323) ship with the plugin, so they look the same without internet.

## Fixed
- **The bar now fills to current / goal, like its label.** Before, it measured from the value the goal started at, so after an automatic next goal of 500 → 1000, 514 subscribers showed an almost empty bar next to "514 / 1K". **Reset goal** now only re-arms the celebration (and, with *Auto next goal*, moves an already reached goal up by the step).

## Updating
From 0.1.1 or 0.1.2, Goal Bar offers this update automatically (or use **Tools → Goal Bar: Check for updates**). From 0.1.0, replace the plugin folder by hand once.

## Downloads
| Platform | File | Install to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon, 13+) | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.3-macos-arm64.zip` | `~/Library/Application Support/obs-studio/plugins/` |
| Windows x64 | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.3-windows-x64.zip` | `C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\` |
| Linux x86_64 | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `~/.config/obs-studio/plugins/` |

The macOS bundle is ad-hoc signed; if macOS blocks it, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine` on the installed `.plugin` (see README).

All three packages are built and unit-tested in CI from the same commit.
